tasks.title: 确定Commit Ledger canonical owner和事实源边界
tasks.prompt:
基于第一阶段盘点结果，确定 Commit Ledger 的：

1. Canonical owner: control-plane
2. 数据采集边界：projects (11) + products (5) + shared/infra/tools (8) = 24 仓库
3. 事实源优先级：Git commit > submit log > CHANGELOG > test report
4. 数据权限边界：只读 Git，存储在 control-plane
5. 读写边界：Collector 写，API 读，UI 展示
6. 输出 ADR 文档到 services/control-plane/src/commit-ledger/ADR-001-canonical-owner.md

验证命令: test -f /Volumes/code/workspace/projects/axi-workbench/services/control-plane/src/commit-ledger/ADR-001-canonical-owner.md

tasks.title: Commit Ledger v1 JSON Schema
tasks.prompt:
创建 Commit Ledger v1 数据模型 schema：

1. 创建 /packages/commit-ledger-schema/src/commit-ledger.v1.schema.json
2. 必须字段：schemaVersion, recordId (sha256), repo.repoId, commit.sha, commit.parentShas, commit.subject, commit.body, commit.type, commit.scope, actor (redacted), refs, diff, trailers, workspaceState, verification, provenance, ingestion
3. repoId + commitSha 作为幂等键
4. provenance.source 必须可枚举：git|submit-log|changelog|test-report
5. ingestion.status 必须可枚举：new|updated|unchanged|conflict
6. 验证命令: ajv validate -s ./src/commit-ledger.v1.schema.json -d ./test-fixtures/*.json

验证命令: test -f /Volumes/code/workspace/projects/axi-workbench/packages/commit-ledger-schema/src/commit-ledger.v1.schema.json && cat /Volumes/code/workspace/projects/axi-workbench/packages/commit-ledger-schema/src/commit-ledger.v1.schema.json | jq '.properties.recordId'

tasks.title: Git commit collector 实现
tasks.prompt:
实现全量/增量 Git commit collector：

1. 创建 services/control-plane/src/commit-ledger/collector.ts
2. 读取第一阶段盘点结果确定的所有 24 个 Git 仓库
3. 实现增量采集：支持 --since, --until, --limit 参数
4. 实现幂等：基于 repoId + commitSha 生成 recordId
5. 采集所有必要字段：sha, parents, subject, body, author, committer, time, refs, diff stat, trailers
6. 采集 provenance：采集命令、时间
7. 单仓库失败隔离
8. 输出 JSONL 到 /tmp/commit-ledger-{timestamp}.jsonl

验证命令: cd /Volumes/code/workspace/projects/axi-workbench && node -e "const c = require('./services/control-plane/src/commit-ledger/collector'); console.log(typeof c.collect)"

tasks.title: Evidence linker 和质量状态归一化
tasks.prompt:
